UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Non-PII root account metadata acting as the Master Gate parent document for cloud-synced encrypted vaults.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display label for the authenticated workspace user.

syncEnabled.description: Whether automatic zero-knowledge encrypted cloud sync is enabled.

relistingAlertEnabled.description: Whether automated re-listing digest alerts are enabled.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest account update.

UserPrivateContact.title: UserPrivateContact
UserPrivateContact.description: Isolated PII sub-document storing owner contact and re-listing digest recipient email addresses.

ownerId.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching parent UserAccount.

email.description: Verified account email address isolated from root profile.

alertRecipientEmail.description: Destination email address for automated re-listing digest alerts.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest private contact update.

EncryptedCloudVault.title: EncryptedCloudVault
EncryptedCloudVault.description: Zero-knowledge client-encrypted AES-256-GCM workspace vault envelope syncing scan profiles, receipts, and 45-day SLA trackers across devices.

ownerId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the vault owner.

kdfAlgorithm.description: Key derivation function used to derive the vault key from the user's passphrase.

payloadSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 integrity digest of ciphertextBase64.

exposedCount.description: Non-PII count of exposed broker records in this snapshot.

removedCount.description: Non-PII count of verified removed broker records.

trackedCount.description: Non-PII count of submitted/tracked SLA broker records.

profilesCount.description: Non-PII count of stored search profiles (0..10).

deviceLabel.description: Sanitized label of the device that pushed this encrypted snapshot.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest encrypted vault push.

/users/{userId}.description: Master Gate root account document per authenticated user (contains zero PII).

/users/{userId}/private/{contactId}.description: Split-collection isolated PII contact document strictly accessible only to the verified owner.

/users/{userId}/vaults/{vaultId}.description: Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM encrypted workspace vault snapshot synced across the owner's devices.
